subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Feiyu in <Picture 1>, an adult woman with blue hair, whale ornaments, navy-and-white clothes and the existing cheek and lip injuries.

summary: [keyframe completion + audio reference] In a four-second handheld POV shot, <Subject 1>'s face is lifted toward the viewer while the assailant delivers his threat in the voice of <Audio 1>.
retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: partially_preserved - her appearance, clothes and injuries continue as her head rises.
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] opening): partially_preserved - the close framing, starting pose, hair-holding hand and warehouse lighting.
<Audio 1>: reference - the assailant's voice identity.
detailed_description: [Shot 1] Photorealistic live-action, landscape 16:9. Cold hard side light from camera-left, subdued blue-gray warehouse. First-person handheld POV, looking directly at Feiyu in the close framing of <Picture 1>. Her head is bowed and a black-sleeved hand holds her hair. The offscreen assailant (S2), with the male voice of <Audio 1>, immediately says in brisk, forceful Mandarin: <d>[Chinese] 想让她活着回来，就把钱转过来。</d> His clear voice comes through the call. As he speaks, the hand pulls her face up once, revealing her bruised cheek and injured lip. Feiyu opens her eyes and looks straight into the lens, silently listening. The viewpoint settles after a short step, then leans a little closer with small irregular handheld drift. Her eyes stay on the viewer as he finishes the sentence with a short comma pause. The shot ends on her raised face and the hand still holding her hair. The camera and its operator remain behind the viewpoint. No subtitles or dialogue text overlays.
overall_soundscape: Low warehouse ambience, a settling footstep, light clothing rustle and Feiyu's quiet breathing beneath the speech.

metadata.prompt:

<Subject 1> is Feiyu (S3) in <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>, with blue hair, whale ornaments, navy-and-white clothes, the existing injuries and her wrists restrained behind the chair.
<Picture 1> is the face-and-shoulders opening of [Shot 1], with her face raised toward the viewer.
<Picture 2> is the waist-level close framing for [Shot 2], from her collarbones to the top of her lap, with the flat white apron waist panel and the chair sides visible.
<Picture 3> is the preceding A1 final frame, supplying the incoming warehouse state.
<Audio 1> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 1> (S3).
summary: [keyframe completion + audio reference] <Subject 1> reassures the viewer in close-up, then a cut to <Picture 2>'s framing shows one quick abdominal punch after her complete sentence. The two shots occupy four seconds.
retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: partially_preserved - her appearance, costume, injuries and restraint continue through speaking and the blow.
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] opening): partially_preserved - the raised face, direct eyeline and close framing.
<Picture 2> ([Shot 2] opening): partially_preserved - the abdomen framing, flat apron waist panel and upright chair sides.
<Picture 3>: partially_preserved - preserve the preceding raised-head state, hair grip, injuries and upright chair; it does not repeat the head lift or determine the new tighter crop. Incoming continuity reference: <Picture 3>.
<Audio 1>: reference - Feiyu's voice identity.
detailed_description: [Shot 1] Photorealistic live-action, landscape 16:9. Cold hard side light from camera-left, subdued blue-gray warehouse. First-person handheld POV in <Picture 1>'s frontal face-and-shoulders close-up. Feiyu (S3) looks directly into the lens, addresses Dongqing and immediately says in the female voice of <Audio 1>, breathless but speaking quickly and distinctly: <d>[Chinese] 主人，别管我……我没事。</d> She takes a short breath at the ellipsis and keeps looking at the viewer through the final word. The black-sleeved hand holds her hair while the framing drifts slightly with the operator's grip. [Shot 2] At 00:03.200, after her complete sentence, cut to the waist-level close-up in <Picture 2> from the same frontal side. A short straight punch enters horizontally from frame-left, strikes the flat white apron waist panel below the gathered bodice and above the skirt pleats, then immediately withdraws to frame-left. Feiyu doubles forward sharply at the waist: her shoulders and blue hair drop into the upper half of this close-up as her abdomen folds and her breath catches. The existing hair-holding hand follows her head downward. Her hips remain on the seat, her wrists behind the upright chair. End on the folded torso after the fist has withdrawn. The camera and its operator remain behind the viewpoint. Spoken dialogue is audio only and never appears as written words on screen.
overall_soundscape: Quiet warehouse ambience and breathing, followed by one dry impact, a caught breath and clothing friction after the reassurance.

metadata.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Feiyu in <Picture 1>, with blue hair, whale ornaments, navy-and-white clothes, the existing injuries and wrists restrained behind the wooden chair.
<Picture 1> supplies the frontal warehouse opening composition: her head is lowered, a hand grips her hair and the chair is upright.
<Picture 2> is the current A2 final frame, showing the contracted waist, clothing, arms leading behind the body and upright chair sides within its close crop.
<Picture 3> is the preceding B final frame, supplying the separate bedroom state.
<Audio 1> is the voice-timbre reference for Dongqing (S1), heard offscreen from his bedroom.
<Audio 2> is the creator-selected A1 voice-timbre reference for the offscreen assailant (S2).
summary: [keyframe completion + audio reference] In one six-second handheld warehouse POV shot, the assailant releases and kicks <Subject 1> over, threatens her as she struggles on the floor, and Dongqing calls out. <Audio 2> supplies the assailant's voice and <Audio 1> supplies Dongqing's voice.
retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: partially_preserved - her appearance, injuries, clothing and rear wrist restraint continue as she falls with the chair.
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] opening): partially_preserved - the initial lowered head, hair grip, upright chair and frontal warehouse viewpoint; the grip releases and the chair falls during the shot.
<Picture 2>: partially_preserved - the visible contracted waist, blue-and-white clothing, arms leading behind the body and upright chair sides after the abdominal blow; this close crop supplies the current torso state within the wider opening of <Picture 1>.
<Picture 3>: partially_preserved - the separate bedroom state only, used as the required preceding actual end reference; it does not place Dongqing, his phone or bedroom lighting inside the warehouse. Incoming continuity reference: <Picture 3>.
<Audio 1>: reference - Dongqing's voice identity.
<Audio 2>: reference - the assailant's voice identity from the selected A1 recording.
detailed_description: [Shot 1] Photorealistic live-action, landscape 16:9. Cold hard side light from camera-left, subdued blue-gray warehouse. First-person handheld POV from <Picture 1>'s frontal side, framing Feiyu, her abdomen and chair with landing room on frame-right. At the opening her waist remains contracted as in <Picture 2>, her head is lowered and the black-sleeved hand grips her hair as in <Picture 1>. The offscreen assailant (S2), in the voice of <Audio 2>, immediately demands: <d>[Chinese] 给啊。你等什么呢？</d> He speaks briskly, finishing around 1.25 seconds. As he starts, his fingers open and his hand leaves her hair within the first 0.4 seconds. During the second clause, a shoe enters from frame-left, kicks her clothed abdomen sideways toward frame-right and withdraws by about 0.95 seconds. Feiyu and the chair tip toward frame-right together; her left shoulder and the sideways chair hit the floor around 1.5 seconds. The viewpoint follows the fall and lowers as the operator crouches, with small irregular handheld corrections and continuous background perspective changes. Immediately after the landing, around 1.55 seconds, the same offscreen assailant (S2) says: <d>[Chinese] 你要是不给，可别怪我不客气。</d> The first clause is impatient; after the comma his voice lowers into a breathy, sleazy smile, making the latter clause an intimate, insinuating threat. He speaks the phrase continuously and finishes around 4.8 seconds. His words sound like the clear but smaller voice coming from Dongqing's phone speaker. During the threat, Feiyu strains to get up: her head and near shoulder visibly rise together from the floor, pulling her upper torso off the ground. Her wrists stay bound behind the fallen chair; without a hand to brace her weight, she loses the lift and her shoulder drops back onto the floor as the sentence ends. This is one clear rise and collapse. The camera stays on her face, shoulder and the sideways chair. At about 4.9 seconds Dongqing (S1), in the voice of <Audio 1>, shouts from his bedroom: <d>[Chinese] 肥鱼！</d> His shout is close, full and much louder than the assailant's phone voice, with both syllables complete by about 5.7 seconds. Feiyu breathes on the floor while both men remain offscreen. End on her lying beside the fallen chair as the shout fades. The camera and its operator remain behind the viewpoint throughout this continuous shot. No subtitles or dialogue text overlays.
overall_soundscape: Low warehouse ambience, clothing friction during the kick, one chair crash and landing, then a short scrape and strained breathing during the failed effort to rise.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.000, cut to the fixed right-hand detail of <Picture 2>. His fingers keep gripping the ivory blanket; the fabric rises with his rapid breathing. At 00:01.550, a second, softer and slower sleeping breath becomes audible close to his own right, distinct from his panting. [Shot 3] At 00:02.000, cut to the bed composition of <Picture 3>. Hearing that nearby sleeping breath, Dongqing turns only his head to his own right, toward frame-left Feiyu, and fixes his gaze on her. His right hand stays at the blanket over his chest. comfyValues.4:prompt: 重新生成参考图1的同一关键帧，保持原图镜头角度、景别、床铺环境、床品、人物大小、身体姿态和三人位置完全一致。横向写实影视画面，恰好三名成年人物同床躺卧。画面中央是东青，严格沿用图1中央男性的面容、发型和睡衣，平躺睁眼朝上，右手拢握被口。画面左侧是肥鱼，面容、蓝色头发、鲸鱼发饰和服装依据参考图2，保持图1左侧人物睡卧姿态，脸上无伤。画面右侧是菜包，面容、发型依据参考图3，穿图1中的黑衣与红围巾，保持图1右侧睡卧姿态。严格保持左肥鱼、中东青、右菜包的顺序和原有头部位置、人物间距与遮挡关系，不镜像，不交换身份，不增加人物。自然清晨光，真实皮肤和织物细节，统一透视与光影，无文字。

nodes.title: 019关键帧 · Qwen2.1三参考 · 肥鱼左/东青中/菜包右

comfyValues.4:prompt: 以 <image1> 为构图、人物姿势和卧室场景基准，重新生成一张高质量真人影视剧横向关键帧。画面始终只有三名成年人物，画面从左到右依次是肥鱼、东青、菜包，保持原图的机位、床头、米白色床品、窗边自然日光和三人躺在同一张床上的关系。<image2> 仅用于校正画面左侧肥鱼的人物身份、蓝色长发、鲸鱼发饰和蓝白女仆服；<image3> 仅用于校正画面右侧菜包的人物身份、黑色短发、紫色发夹、黑色短袖和红色围巾。不要把单人参考图变成画中画或站立全身图。肥鱼在最左侧，闭眼熟睡，头轻靠在东青左肩旁；东青是正中央唯一男性，严格保留 <image1> 中的面部身份、黑色睡醒发型和白色短袖睡衣，仰躺睁眼向上看，右手自然攥住胸前被沿，另一只手在画面下缘；菜包在最右侧，闭眼熟睡，脸贴在东青右肩旁。保留三人头部的大小、朝向、自然遮挡与亲密但安静的姿态。画面完整连贯，头发、脸、衣服和被子有清楚连续的轮廓，真实皮肤质感，柔和自然光，写实摄影。
